info.title: Music Media Library API
info.description: Authorized Media Library metadata, resumable authenticated uploads and queued verification/restoration/waveform jobs. Read, edit, upload, restore, process and quota abilities remain separate and never replace core policies. Scoped download URLs, packs, pins and lifecycle HTTP commands remain unfinished. No native/device audio execution.

get.summary: Issue a 60-second actor-scoped verified asset download URL
get.description: Requires music.media.read and music.media.download token abilities, live read/download domain gates and foundation TransferAuthorizer approval for music-media-asset/export. No public or bearer-only URL is issued. Downloads recheck authorization, actor identity, signed URL expiry and asset checksum. Full WAVE responses only; Range requests return 416. Private integrity-verified disk snapshots bound memory usage.

get.summary: Read a current or historical authorized pack
get.description: Requires music.media.read plus the appropriate music.media.packs.read/write/import/export ability and live core policies. Import/export also require foundation transfer approval; export additionally enforces pack distribution and per-asset provenance/distribution policies. No audio or storage paths are embedded. Import creates a new pack only; preview validates source format and mapping shape, while commit verifies every destination reference and provenance. JSON transfer bodies are bounded to 8 MiB; saves to 64 KiB.

get.summary: Read the current actor-owned offline pin set
get.description: Requires music.media.read and music.media.pins.read (GET) or music.media.pins.write (PUT), live pin and per-asset read policies, and retain authorization for writes/replays. PUT requires Idempotency-Key and one strong quoted If-Match revision (zero creates). Empty asset_ids releases this pin only. New leases must be future UTC values. Replays return their original receipt without renewing or reverting later saves; GET returns current state. This server retention record does not prove local download completion or implement offline synchronization.

get.description: Requires music.media.read plus music.media.trash.read (browse), music.media.trash.write (trash), or music.media.restore (recovery), and live Core policies. Trash rejects revision, pack or active-pin protection atomically and never deletes bytes. Recovery runs on a queue under the canonical requester with current policy checks. Cancellation and recovery serialize on the task record. Result resolves current availability rather than trusting a historical receipt. Physical garbage collection remains an operator-only Core workflow.
